audit_logging_requirements: (customer asks) Must export structured logs to their SIEM (Splunk/Elastic/Datadog) with both real-time streaming and S3 archival. Preferred transport: syslog over TLS (syslog-ng) or HTTPS JSON-lines endpoint. Logs must include request and response metadata but be configurable to redact PII and full prompt text for production. Support for HEC (Splunk) and Elastic Beats preferred.
log_schema_summary: Customer requested JSON schema; suggested fields below. They want field-level definitions and examples for ingestion mappings. Fields: timestamp, iso8601; request_id; customer_account_id; user_id (nullable); client_ip (anonymize option); route_name; model_name; model_version; prompt_hash (sha256); prompt_redaction_level; response_status (200/4xx/5xx); token_count_input; token_count_output; latency_ms; cache_hit (true/false); kv_cache_event (evict/load); kms_key_id (if envelope encryption used); encryption_context; audit_action (generate, retrieve, delete); sampling_rate (for full prompt capture); redaction_version; host_instance_id; region; deployment_type (private/dedicated).
retention_policy_and_requirements: Default: hot logs (30 days) in SIEM, warm (90 days) in managed S3, cold archive (7 years) on customer-managed storage for regulatory needs. Customer requires immutable retention option and WORM support for specific accounts. Need to confirm SLA for log delivery and replays. Legal wants 7 years for transaction-related prompts, but product recommends redaction + hash-only for long-term retention.
access_logs_and_admin_audit: Separate admin/audit channel required: identity of operator actions (deploy model, change routing, key rotation), with SAML assertion UID and IP, stored separately from request logs and retained 3-5 years. Must include before/after snapshots for config changes. Support for pushing to cloud-native audit pipelines (CloudWatch/Stackdriver) or customer SIEM via secure connector.
siem_export_and_integration_notes:
- Need a POC exporter: support Splunk HEC token + HTTPS ingestion, Elastic index template, Datadog logs ingestion.
- Backpressure and retry semantics critical: prefer at-least-once with dedupe id (request_id) vs exactly-once impossibility.
- Recommended delivery: streaming + periodic batch flush to S3 for compliance archives.
- Encryption in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (SSE-KMS) for S3 archives.
- Provide sample ingestion pipeline config for their SOC team.
